jobs.description:
Company description:
.
Job description:     
 What you will do? 
As Senior Sales Manager BESS – Germany & Central Europe, you will drive our growth by developing the German market, converting complex opportunities and building long-term customer and partner relationships. Reporting to the Head of Sales EU & International, you will work closely with Volvo Energy’s commercial and technical teams to:
 •    Build and convert the BESS pipeline in Germany, with responsibility for selected Central European markets.•    Execute account and market plans, delivering sales volume, profitability and pipeline-quality targets.•    Commercialize BESS solutions and services for Commercial & Industrial, EV charging and selected utility-scale applications.•    Take direct responsibility for originating, developing and closing complex BESS sales, from initial customer engagement through tendering, negotiation, contracting and delivery handover.•    Coordinate internal specialists and external partners to create competitive customer solutions.•    Shape customer offerings, business models, pricing, financing options, partnerships and commercial agreements.•    Build senior relationships with customers, developers, utilities and channel partners across the region.
  
 Your future team
 Join a close-knit, international team building a new business within Volvo Group. We combine the pace, ownership and entrepreneurial mindset of a start-up with the reach, expertise and stability of a global organization.
 You will work across sales, sales engineering, product, operations, finance and legal in a culture of collaboration, trust, accountability and initiative.
  
 This is how you day will look like as Senior Sales Manager BESS
 A typical day focuses on visiting customers, understanding their needs and challenges, and using your market knowledge and experience to identify opportunities and create value. You’ll discuss proposals, develop solutions together, and lead negotiations through to signed agreements. Alongside your customer work, you’ll help shape the business direction and bring colleagues together to turn ideas into action. 
  
 Who are you? 
You are a commercially driven BESS professional who builds markets and trusted customer relationships, taking ownership from first contact to signed contract. You bring:
  •    A proven track record of originating, developing and closing BESS sales or project opportunities in Commercial & Industrial, EV charging or utility-scale applications.•    Strong commercial understanding of BESS, supported by technical knowledge of grid connection, electrical infrastructure, system design, project development and contracting.•    Experience with German or DACH energy-market customers and procurement processes, including RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, tenders, negotiations and contract award.•    Understanding of BESS business models and value streams, including ancillary services, energy arbitrage, peak shaving, flexibility and revenue stacking.•    Professional fluency in German and English, with the ability to lead commercial and technical discussions in both languages.•    A relevant university degree—or equivalent professional experience—in energy, engineering, business or commercial management.•    Strong commercial judgement, drive and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to manage several opportunities and travel regularly within Germany and Central Europe.
 What’s in it for you? 
Help shape sustainable energy solutions while developing your career in an international environment. We offer:
  
 •    An attractive package with fixed salary and performance-related variable compensation.•    A company car under the applicable company car policy.•    Mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.•    Autonomy to shape our BESS business in Germany and Central Europe.•    International collaboration and development opportunities across Volvo Group.
  
 Location and working model: Based at Volvo Group Trucks Central Europe GmbH in Ismaning, near Munich, with mobile working in line with company policy and business requirements.
  
 Ready for the next move? 
Ready to help shape Volvo Energy’s BESS business in Germany and Central Europe? We would be pleased to hear from you.We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply if you are motivated by creating customer value and contributing to the energy transition—even if your experience does not cover every area listed.
  
 Feel free to contact me if you have further questions  
 Hiring Manager: Belén Neira, Head of Sales EU & International
 Preferred start date: January 2027Application deadline: 3 December 2026   We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.   As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable. 
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

Job ID: 6456
Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.
In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.
You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders. 
About our team
Core Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.
Main responsibilities in this role: 
Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.
Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.
Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.
Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.
Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.
Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.
Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.
Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.
Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.
Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.
Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.
Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement. 

Who you are
Your background and skills include: 
Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.
Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.
Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.
Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.
Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.
Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.
Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.
Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.
Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.
Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.
Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.
Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.
Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.
Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.
Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.
A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.

The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.
If this sounds like you, get in touch!
Next steps
​Submit your application no later than 16/10/2026.
The recruitment process consists of the following steps:
Preliminary CV selection
Online interview with the hiring leader
Background check

Join us as a Senior Reliability Engineer and play a key role in ensuring the long-term performance and reliability of critical manufacturing assets.
The position is part of the local Maintenance & Reliability organisation in Uppsala and works cross-functionally with Engineering, Production, Quality Assurance and other key stakeholders.
As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will act as a key technical specialist on both operational and strategic levels, driving the development of a proactive, data-driven reliability and maintenance culture. You will also collaborate closely with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with corporate standards, best practices and long-term strategic objectives.
We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive mindset, takes ownership of complex challenges and is motivated by turning analysis into action.
Make your mark. Grow with us. 
 
Your mission
As a Senior Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability and long-term performance of manufacturing systems and equipment across our operations.
Using data, engineering expertise and structured problem solving, you will identify improvement opportunities, assess equipment and asset lifecycles, and support decisions on maintenance strategies, upgrades and future investments.
In this role, you will provide subject matter expertise in reliability engineering and asset performance management, supporting both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic initiatives. Through collaboration with local and global stakeholders, you will help shape maintenance practices, improve asset reliability and contribute to sustainable business performance.
This is a senior role that requires a high degree of ownership and initiative. You are comfortable working independently, building strong relationships across functions and driving improvements from idea through to implementation.
You will join a team of experienced engineers who play an important role in supporting operational excellence and the continued development of our Uppsala site.
 
Key Responsibilities
· Drive reliability engineering initiatives across manufacturing operations, systems and equipment.
· Lead and facilitate reliability assessments using methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA and FMECA.
· Analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement measurable reliability improvements.
· Develop and optimise preventive maintenance strategies to improve asset availability and reduce operational risk.
· Support asset lifecycle management and contribute to investment decisions through data-driven recommendations.
· Monitor and improve maintenance performance indicators (KPIs) and reliability metrics.
· Collaborate with stakeholders across Engineering, Production, Automation, QA and Facilities to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.
· Collaborate with Galderma's global reliability organisation to ensure alignment with company standards and strategic objectives.
· Promote a proactive, reliability-focused culture through coaching, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.
· Lead root cause investigations and drive corrective and preventive actions to improve operational performance
 
Your profile 
You are an experienced engineer with a background in reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management within an industrial environment.
You are comfortable working with complex technical challenges and understand how to translate data into practical actions and long-term improvements. Equally important, you take ownership, build trust with stakeholders and thrive in an environment where initiative and collaboration are valued.
 
What you'll bring
· A university degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
· Minimum 5 years of experience within reliability engineering, maintenance engineering or asset management in an industrial environment.
· Strong knowledge and practical experience of reliability methodologies such as RCA, RCM, FMEA/FMECA and preventive maintenance optimisation.
· Proven ability to analyse equipment performance, identify failure patterns and implement sustainable reliability improvements.
· Experience working with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) and maintenance performance indicators (KPIs).
· Strong knowledge of asset lifecycle management and maintenance strategies.
· Experience from a regulated manufacturing environment.
· Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
· Professional proficiency in English, written and spoken. Swedish is considered an advantage.
 
Location and other
This position is based on site in Uppsala, Sweden. We review applications on an ongoing basis and the position may be filled before the final application date. We therefore encourage interested candidates to submit their application as soon as possible.
 
Why Galderma
At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
 
With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
 
Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.
 
We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
 
By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
 
Project Director at atNorth
 
Are you an experienced project leader who thrives on taking ownership of complex, large-scale construction projects?
 
We are looking for a Project Director to lead the delivery of one of our major data center projects in Sweden. In this key role, you will have end-to-end accountability from contract award through construction, commissioning and handover to Operations, ensuring the project is delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the quality expected by atNorth and our customers.
 
You will lead the atNorth project organization and act as our senior delivery representative towards the general contractor, customer and key stakeholders. This is an opportunity to combine leadership, commercial expertise and project delivery while contributing directly to atNorth’s continued growth across the Nordics.
 
Key responsibilities
 
 
Take end-to-end ownership of the assigned project, delivering against agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, HSE and Ready for Service (RFS) commitments.

 
Lead the atNorth project organization and build the right team and capabilities for each phase of delivery.

 
Participate in general contractor tendering, evaluation and contract negotiations, and take full accountability from contract award.

 
Manage the GC contract and protect atNorth’s commercial and contractual position, including variations, claims, costs and schedule impacts.

 
Own project cost, schedule and risk forecasting, proactively identifying deviations and escalating risks early.

 
Act as atNorth’s senior delivery interface towards the customer, managing technical requirements, design changes and acceptance.

 
Lead commissioning and integrated systems testing through to successful handover to Operations.

 
Drive a strong health, safety and quality culture, ensuring contracted standards are consistently met.

 
Lead, coach and develop project managers, leads and specialists across the project organization.

 
Ensure strong project governance, reporting, documentation and close-out, while capturing lessons learned to continuously improve future delivery.

 
 
Your profile
 
 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

 
10+ years of experience leading large-scale construction, infrastructure or mission-critical projects.

 
Proven experience of owner-side project delivery, ideally from contract award through construction, commissioning and operational handover.

 
Strong commercial and contractual experience, including contract administration, variations, claims and cost and schedule management.

 
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary project teams, consultants and contractors in complex project environments.

 
Strong stakeholder and customer management skills, with the confidence to make decisions and communicate clearly in challenging situations.

 
Experience from data centers or other mission-critical environments is strongly preferred. Experience from energy, industrial or other complex infrastructure environments is also relevant.

 
Fluency in English is required. Swedish or another relevant local language is preferred.

 
Experience with Nordic construction standards such as ABT 06, or international standards such as FIDIC or NEC, is an advantage. Project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2 is also highly valued.

We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.
We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.
At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

Are you passionate about beer, quality, and production processes? Do you want to be a key player in packaging our award-winning beers? Then you might be our next Team Leader!
Omnipollo AB is a Swedish brewery founded in 2010 by brewer Henok Fentie and designer Karl Grandin. Over the years, the brewery has won numerous awards for its beer and has several bestsellers such as Levon, Nebuchadnezzar, and Noa Pecan Mud Cake. Omnipollo AB exports its beer to 45 countries. Omnipollo AB has a number of restaurants and bars including Omnipollos hatt and Omnipollos kyrka in Stockholm as well as Omnipollos Tokyo in Japan.

As a Team Leader at our packaging facility in Kungsängen, you will play a central role in leading and distributing the daily work. Your main responsibility is to ensure that the daily operations including tanking, centrifugation, pasteurization, packaging, and ongoing equipment maintenance run efficiently and correctly. You will work closely with the Head of Production, the production team at the brewery, and the Warehouse Manager. You will coach, lead, and coordinate the Packaging Operators to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. Together with your colleagues, you will take responsibility for creating a good working environment and developing our operations. The work requires precision to maintain our routines, industry standards, and to produce products of high quality that meet all statutory requirements.
Your Responsibilities:
Leading and overseeing the daily operational work at the packaging facility to ensure efficient and smooth processes.
Coaching and leading Packaging Operators, ensuring their work follows company guidelines and industry standards.
Performing ongoing floor maintenance and planning to minimize production downtime, as well as acting as the main contact for technical repairs (welders, plumbers, electricians, etc.).
Assisting in staff schedule planning in collaboration with the Head of Production.
Acting as a supervisor and mentor for new staff and interns.
Ensuring routines and SOPs are followed in daily work and actively contributing to their development.

As well as being a part of the daily operations:
Operating centrifugation and pasteurization.
Packaging our products.
Logging and documenting work.
Transferring beer out of the brewery and into the packaging facility.
Performing cleaning and CIP (Clean in Place).

Who Are You?
We are looking for someone who has a strong interest in production processes and a natural aptitude for leadership. You are a problem solver who can quickly identify and resolve practical or technical issues that may arise during the packaging and brewing process. You have a desire to motivate a team of brewery workers, delegate tasks effectively, and ensure excellent communication within the group. To succeed in this role, you also need to be competent in performing taste and quality tests to ensure our products meet company standards, and be committed to ensuring the team complies with all food, safety and statutory guidelines.
Qualifications:
Brewery technician education or equivalent.
Minimum 4 years of experience working in packaging at a brewery. 
Experience in a leading or coordinating role with an emphasis on technical aspects is highly meriting.
Solid expertise regarding packaging equipment, centrifugal separators, pasteurizers, the brewing process, and the finished product.
Technical skills to handle and maintain brewery equipment.
Valid B driver’s license and forklift license (Truckkort).
Fluent in English both spoken and written; Swedish is a huge plus.
